## "complete_digitiser_list"

**Data type:**  
List of strings

**Value:**  
Example: ["Mary", "Jane"]

**Description of metadata field:**  
In cases where multiple digitiser has worked as a team to digitise then they will all be included in this list. We wont know who did exactly which part of the digitisation process. All will be given credit for the process. 

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Ingestion server from input when digitisers starts a session.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
complete_digitiser_list

**Maps to in Specify:**  
copyright holders?

**Notes and issues:**  
Requires updating how ARS handles statistics. Needs implementation in ARS and the pipeline.Mapping with specify needs to be defined.
